title: Fifty Hours on a Toilet to Fund Who Gives A Crap's First Run
conflicts: Dated from contemporary coverage: Mumbrella (10 July 2012), HuffPost (12 July 2012), TriplePundit (20 July 2012), GlobalPost (July 2012). Totals differ by date ($53,000+ on 12 July; just over $60,000 on 20 July); TriplePundit's overall $100,000 need is unrepeated and omitted. Setting: HuffPost says 'bathroom', CNBC says the team's empty warehouse; story uses warehouse in Melbourne. Post-launch sales claims (three months' stock sold in five days) rest on a 2019 YPO profile and are attributed.
notes: Stance: complicates (Dhammapada 141 on displays of endurance). The World's page is dated 2016 but is a July 2012 GlobalPost item. IndieGoGo campaign page blocks the verifier and is not cited.
